text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Returning the reference books is complete.
Now, next is—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ah, that book is...!
"Overseas Umamusume Documentary Series"!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The new volume, if I recall... was the sequel about that Umamusume
who faced injury and had the longest active career of her time...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: As expected, this is splendid work.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Injury prevention, mental control.
The sheer amount of trial and error she undergoes
speaks volumes of the heights of her ambition.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Will I... be able to reach it too?
...No, I must reach it, and surpass it.
Together with you, Trainer... and for that—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
For now, please read this book thoroughly.
As for training,
there will surely be a chance to make up for it.

Ikuno Dictus became so engrossed
that she ended up skipping training altogether...
